data.question: I'm frustrated by lack of progress, not laziness. Will this actually help?
data.answer: A book alone won't fix everything, but it gives you the foundational mindset that makes real progress possible. This bundle covers both the professional thinking and client understanding that junior developers typically lack; the gaps that keep people stuck.

data.question: I don't have time to read 150 pages
data.answer: Fair enough. The volumes are designed so you can jump to specific topics when you need them. Each chapter stands alone. You don't have to read cover to cover; grab what you need, when you need it.

data.question: Will this teach me technical skills?
data.answer: There are code examples and practical techniques, but this isn't a coding tutorial. It's about the mindset, principles, and approaches that make you a better developer; the things that separate professionals from people who just write code.

data.question: Why get the bundle instead of buying volumes separately?
data.answer: Two reasons. First, you save **25%** (**€14.99** instead of €19.98). Second, these volumes work together. [Volume 1](/product/dev-concepts-volume-01) builds the professional mindset; [Volume 2](/product/dev-concepts-volume-02) teaches client understanding. One without the other leaves gaps.

data.question: What if I don't like it?
data.answer: Email me within **14 days**, full refund. I just ask that you tell me what didn't work for you so I can improve. No hassle, no interrogation.

data.question: Why only Volumes 1 and 2?
data.answer: I'm releasing new volumes regularly. This starter bundle gives you the first two foundational volumes. If you want all **12 volumes** as they come out, look at the Lifetime Bundle instead.

data.question: What exactly is in each volume?
data.answer: [Volume 1](/product/dev-concepts-volume-01) (**100 pages**): software craftsmanship, mindset, thinking like a professional. [Volume 2](/product/dev-concepts-volume-02) (**50 pages**): understanding client needs, UX basics, requirements discovery. Check [dev-concepts.dev](https://dev-concepts.dev) for detailed chapter breakdowns and free samples.

data.question: Can I just buy one volume?
data.answer: Yes, they're available separately. But the bundle saves you **25%**, and the two topics work together. Professional mindset without client understanding (or vice versa) only gets you halfway there.

data.question: I can't afford this right now...
data.answer: Reach out to me on Twitter or email. I want to help developers grow, regardless of finances. We'll figure something out.

data.question: Can I buy this for my team?
data.answer: Yes. Contact me for group pricing. It's a good way to level up junior developers or establish shared foundations across your team.
